title: Default failure reports to active markers
summary: Reports failure triage now opens in active marker mode by default while preserving latest JSON as an opt-out view.
reason: Cleared historical failure-report rows were reappearing as actionable failures because the Reports page defaulted to latest failure JSON instead of active marker evidence.
behavior_before: Reports > Failures opened with Use failure markers unchecked, so refreshes requested /api/failures?limit=100 and showed latest historical JSON rows by default.
behavior_after: Reports > Failures opens with Use failure markers checked, so refreshes request /api/failures?limit=100&source=markers by default; unchecking the control still requests latest JSON.
manual_validation: ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -SkipToolIntegration -SkipEndToEndSmoke - failed due pre-existing smoke wrapper map freshness drift, duplicate test-name report drift, and MP-CHANGE-2026-0619-020 local workstation path
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed; this change is covered, but 10 unrelated pre-existing worktree files are uncovered
rollback_plan: Remove the checked attribute from the failure-source-markers checkbox and revert the test expectations for marker-default refresh behavior.
notes:
Default Reports failure source checkbox to active markers.
Static guard for marker-source default and failure query contract.
Browser smoke verifies checked marker-source refresh and unchecked latest-JSON refresh.
Refreshed generated summaries for changed Reports UI, tests, and packet.
